# 2 Baruch Chapter 49 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue

---

**49:1** And-I-answered and-said: "In-what-form will-those-live who-live in-your-day? Or-how-will the-glory-of-those-who-come-after-that-time continue?"

**49:2** "Will-they-then resume this-form of-the-present, and-put-on these-fetters which-are-now in-evil, and-by-which all-evil-things are-done?"

**49:3** "Or-will-you perhaps-change these-things which-have-been-in-the-world, as-also the-world-itself?"

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
